Liam (new-hire): hey all! first day — quick q: where's the single source for onboarding templates in Notion? i found a couple of copies but some pages are view-only. who approves duplication/edit rights?

zoe_peopleops: welcome Liam! :tada: Canonical templates live under Notion > Company Home > Processes > Team Templates and Eng space > Onboarding. For edit/duplicate we add folks to role groups (Engineering Editors) or approve individual requests. DM me your work email and i'll add you.

arin_docs: if you see view-only hit 'Request access' and leave a one-line reason like "ramp + need RFC copy". that creates a docs ticket. ping @arin_docs in the request and i can fast-track it. note: some templates are duplication-locked to keep canonical provenance.

pat_eng: also FYI, several runbooks live in Eng > Playbooks and are restricted to team members. if you need temporary access for onboarding, ask here with the repo/page link and duration and we can grant a time-limited permission.

Liam (new-hire): thanks! my email is liam@redwood.com. i want to copy the RFC template into my private workspace first, then move a polished version into Eng > RFCs. any preferred naming convention?

zoe_peopleops: for visibility we prefer "Last, First — Ramp" (e.g., "Nguyen, Liam — Ramp") for personal ramp notes if you want them easily sortable by last name. for team-shared ramps append the team in parentheses: "Nguyen, Liam — Ramp (Eng)". for RFCs, use status prefixes: "[WIP] Short title" -> when final remove prefix and add published tag.

arin_docs: small tip: when duplicating templates, clear the metadata block (owner/date) and search/replace any internal link shortcodes. if you need help moving pages between spaces without breaking links, i can assist.

Liam (new-hire): awesome, invite please?

docs-bot: docs-requests  ticket DR-12987 created for liam@redwood.com (requested by zoe_peopleops). Link: https://notion.company/requests/DR-12987

arin_docs: approved DR-12987, adding Liam to Engineering Editors. you should get the Notion invite in a few mins. welcome aboard! :rocket:
